desc: Easily installed on your Remington 597, the ARCHANGEL AA597R adjustable six-position stock features a drop-in fit that requires no gunsmithing. Proprietary carbon fiber filled polymer construction will ensure a lifetime of hard use. Makes your Remington 597 mimic the look and feel of an M-4 carbine. Features an ergonomic pistol grip with finger grooves, 2 secure storage compartments, 6 position buttstock, 4 Quick Detach sling swivel hard points and a muzzle attachment that allows attachment of gas-block height sights on OEM barrels. It has a full length top Picatinny rail and a 6 o'clock Picatinny rail on forend. The forend sides are slotted for the addition of optional Picatinny rails. A black, high strength polymer display bayonet and tactical mag release are also included.
